messages:
alice: quick sanity check request — planning to cut v2.5.0 tonight. Can we run a full pre-deploy green sweep on staging (e2e + unit + the kv-cache flaky set)? Cutoff is 18:00 UTC. Who can help?

ben: I'm available. Starting a full green-sweep now, will post the CI link.

ci-bot: Started pipeline staging-green-sweep #1987 — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/1987 (triggered by @ben)

carla: heads-up: we've been seeing intermittent failures in tests/test_kv.py::test_eviction_policy on mac-x86. Saw it twice yesterday. I can triage if assigned. :eyes:

drew: assigning @carla and @erin to triage flaky_kv. @ben please hold merge queue if you see regressions.

erin: will try to repro locally. If I can, I'll push a quick harness fix (add a retry + better logging). Carla — can you paste the exact failing stack when you have it?

carla: failing stack (from last CI run):
```
FAILED tests/test_kv.py::test_eviction_policy
E   AssertionError: expected keys 0-3 present, got [0,1,2]
E   AssertionError: item missing after eviction trigger

--- captured stdout ---
put keys 0..3
eviction triggered
remaining keys: [0,1,2]
```
Probably a race with the eviction timer.

ben: CI ~10% in, ETA ~12m. If the flaky reproduces on staging I'll cancel and re-run isolated job with more logs.

ci-bot: staging-green-sweep #1987 — 3/120 jobs failed (failing job: tests/test_kv.py::test_eviction_policy on mac-latest). Rerunning failed jobs...

frank: reminder — changelog for v2.5.0 needed. Please add brief bullet under "Serving runtime" about kernel selection fixes. I'll merge changelog at 17:30 UTC. :alarm_clock: 

gina: canary plan: after we get a clean green, roll canary to 10% for 30m and watch token-latency + error-rate dashboards. If those hold, we ramp.

ben: rerun finished — all jobs green except the kv eviction flake (failed twice on mac-latest). Holding merge queue and skipping branch freeze until test fix PR lands.

carla: opened PR #2345 with a retry in the test harness + extra logging: https://git.internal/pr/2345 — requesting review from @drew. Notes in PR: defense against eviction timer race, also adds more dumps when assertion fails.

drew: reviewing PR now. If CI passes on the PR, let's fast-track it and unblock the release.

erin: quick note — if we can't get a reliable repro, we should consider adding the test as flaky with a TODO + tracking ticket, then cut the release. Prefer to fix but don't want to miss cutoff.

alice: agreed — prefer fix but if PR doesn't land by 17:15 UTC, tag the test as flaky with a follow-up ticket and proceed. Frank — can you still handle changelog merge at 17:30?

frank: yes I'll merge changelog at 17:30 if PR status is green or we decide to proceed without the test.

ci-bot: PR #2345 — CI started, running 24 jobs.

ben: PR #2345 CI is green on all jobs. @drew any blockers from review?

drew: LGTM, left a tiny nit. Approving now. If no other issues, remove hold and proceed with cut. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Branch protection hold removed by @drew.

ben: sweep complete — staging green. Proceeding with canary per Gina's plan (10% for 30m). Will post monitor links.

ci-bot: Canary rollout initiated (10%) — monitor: https://observability/redwood/canary/1919990000

gina: monitoring now — token-latency stable, no errors spike after 15m. Continue ramp after 30m.

alice: thanks all — excellent sweep. Changelog merged by @frank. Cutting v2.5.0 after canary window. :tada:

ci-bot: Release v2.5.0 created and tag pushed: v2.5.0 — https://git.internal/releases/v2.5.0
